backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend for a general store app, including state and endpoints for user profiles, products, orders, recharge orders, carts, bills, shop status, and UPI settings with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (shop status toggle bug fix, admin write confirmation, error feedback) to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key behaviors, serving as a reference for the frontend codebase structure and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Maa Bhawani General Store PWA, including meta tags for viewport, theme color, PWA/Apple web app support, manifest link, and Google Fonts.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store defining app name, display mode, theme colors, and icon references for 192px, 512px, and 180px sizes.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle handlers for cache versioning.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes including home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin, billing, settings, search, my-orders, and wallet pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that restricts access to admin-only pages by verifying a hardcoded Admin ID/password via a login dialog and caching the session in localStorage for 24 hours. Also checks the caller's on-chain admin status via the `useIsCallerAdmin` hook.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the backend, supporting fields like name, category, price, barcode, unit type, stock, and an image (file upload or URL). Validates inputs and calls the `useAddProduct` mutation on submission.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays all products in an admin list view with inline stock editing, product removal, and toggling product exclusion. Shows a low-stock alert for products with fewer than 5 units.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that dynamically loads the Quagga2 library from CDN and uses it to scan barcodes via the device camera. Supports flash toggling, haptic feedback, beep audio, and scan cooldown to prevent duplicate reads.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable, filterable table of past bills with options to view, print, or export bills as CSV. Uses a dialog with `BillTemplate` to display individual bill details.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, displaying order items, totals, delivery charges, and a UPI QR code, with actions to print or share via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with Home, Search, My Orders, and Wallet links, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Floating action button fixed to the bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the store's number.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-in cart drawer showing cart items, subtotal, and a checkout button, with shop-closed state handling and a clear-cart option.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontally scrollable category filter bar that highlights the selected category and calls a callback on selection.
Static alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51 within 1km, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches render errors and displays an error alert with stack trace details and reset/home actions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying store name, contact info, Google Maps link, delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header with store logo, shop open/closed indicator, cart icon with item count badge, admin dashboard link, and Internet Identity login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing carousel component displaying three promotional store banners with navigation arrows, dot indicators, and a 4-second auto-play interval.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that renders Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and conditionally shows BottomNavBar and WhatsAppHelpButton for non-admin routes.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Section component for placing mobile recharge orders, featuring a form dialog with operator selection, amount input, and validation, disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Card component that displays a UPI payment QR code image along with the order amount and step-by-step payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component for a single product showing its image, name, category, price, stock status, and an add-to-cart button that is disabled when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Grid component that fetches and displays all products filtered by an optional category, showing skeleton loaders while loading and an empty-state image when no products match.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Banner component that renders a red full-width closed-shop notice only when the shop status is confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Alert dialog that automatically appears when the shop transitions from open to closed, prompting the user to return to the home page.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin toggle component that reads and updates the shop open/closed status via a Switch, displaying loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: Fixed floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat with the store's phone number when clicked.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for backend interactions including user profiles, shop status, products, orders, bills, and recharge orders.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and includes print styles and a barcode scanner laser animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying tabbed views for managing orders (with status progression actions), products, bill history, and shop status toggle.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing configuration of the store slogan, UPI payment ID, and an emergency shop-close action with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that lets staff search/scan products, manage a cart, enter customer details, and generate a printable bill using the generateBill mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page that collects delivery details and payment method (UPI or COD), calculates totals with a conditional delivery fee, and places an order via the placeOrder mutation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page composing a hero carousel, shop-closed banner, category filter, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Placeholder page for order history that displays a coming-soon message with a shopping bag icon.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that shows the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or a cash-on-delivery notice, reading order totals from sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Placeholder search page that displays a coming-soon message with a search icon.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static store information page showing contact, location, hours, delivery policy, services, and an embedded Google Maps iframe for Maa Bhawani General Store.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Placeholder wallet page that displays a coming-soon message with a wallet icon.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback for sensitive tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch CSS variables), border radii, fonts, shadows, and accordion animations, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state including version, architectural notes, known bugs (e.g., shop status revert bug), and a list of existing features/fix requests related to admin write reliability, error feedback, and shop status sync.
